block.title: In-game enemy sprite sheet: dune worm, dust devil, husk crawler
block.positive: Retro 16-bit pixel art sprite atlas for a desert level of a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up, flat solid dark blue-navy sheet background, generous even margins, absolutely no text, numbers or annotations. Content, all facing left: a mechanical boring-worm drawn as separable parts — a ring-plated brass head with a spiral drill jaw in four rev states, plain body rings for extending its length, and a tail plug — plus a little sand-burst effect sprite in two expand frames; a family of DUST DEVIL funnels, four translucent rust-vapor whirls whose internal shear bands and hollow dark cores step through a spin cycle, tiny pebbles caught at orbiting positions; squat armoured HUSK CRAWLER beetles, slate carapace built from overlapping plates over six chunky legs, four-frame walk cycle, plus one belly-open frame revealing a glowing violet weak-point core. Bold near-black outlines throughout, sand-gold, rust, brass and slate palette with violet and red accents, chunky readable pixels, dithering only on metal, no anti-aliasing, nothing else on the sheet.
block.negative: photorealistic, 3d, gradients, smooth shading, text, watermark, sand dunes background, cactus, real beetle, pure black background, overlapping sprites, perspective distortion
block.notes: Modular worm parts make this sheet directly usable for a segment-builder mockup. sd3.5 at 5.5 holds the grid; flux.1-dev if it produces cleaner leg silhouettes at the cost of layout. Color reference: sand-burst #fce8b8, core violet #b84cff family.
